transcript: I don't know what side of TikTok y'all are on, but over the last month I have seen more and more videos pop up on my FYP about how people could have predicted the election results because of the rise in conservative fashion trends. And all I have to say is that many people, myself included, oh, Rebecca Frackle and apology. The cabaret revival just hits. It hits a little harder now. Also, if you haven't seen it with the new cast, they are absolutely fantastic. I usually don't do reviews for replacement cast, but like, they're. They're all stellar. And I'm so glad. I'm so glad we finally got Adam Lambert on Broadway because he is so good.
